overview_description.description: WeReno is an AI owner's representative that helps building owners plan and manage renovations, capital projects, and property improvements. It automatically analyzes drawings, generates scopes of work, estimates costs, prepares RFQs, coordinates vendors, and tracks project execution, giving owners the capabilities of an experienced owner's rep through software.

product.name: Owner’s Rep as a Service Platform
product.description: A platform that manages construction projects by overseeing all phases from planning to execution, focusing on risk reduction, collaboration, and operational efficiency.

product.name: AI-Driven Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that monitors project progress, identifies risks, and provides real-time solutions to keep construction projects on schedule and within budget.

product.name: Dynamic and Interactive Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing real-time updates and data visualizations on all aspects of construction projects to enhance transparency and collaboration.

product.name: Automated Compliance and Quality Assurance
product.description: A system that automates compliance checks and quality assurance tasks to ensure construction projects meet industry standards with reduced human error.

product.name: Predictive Analytics
product.description: Analytical tools that forecast potential budget and scheduling issues to enable proactive project adjustments and risk management.
